content: {"paper_id":"W2076398700","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"pairwise-constraint-propagation","exact_quote":"Our approach allows the initial pairwise constraints to be propagated throughout the entire multi-modal dataset.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文明确提出将初始成对约束传播至整个多模态数据集，属于成对约束传播任务。"},{"keyword_id":"multi-view-learning","exact_quote":"multi-modal data or a dataset with multiple representations","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文处理多模态数据与多表示数据，并显式联合多模态约束传播，符合多视图学习设定。"},{"keyword_id":"semi-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"exploiting pairwise constraints for constrained clustering tasks on multi-modal datasets","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"利用成对约束指导多模态数据的约束聚类，属于有限成对约束指导全部样本学习的半监督设定。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-structure-learning","exact_quote":"The propagated constraints are further used to refine the similarities between the objects for subsequent clustering tasks.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"传播后的约束用于修正对象间相似度，即学习/修正样本间亲和关系，符合图结构学习定义。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-manifold-regularization","exact_quote":"multi-graph based two-class label propagation subproblems","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"方法将问题分解为多图上的两分类标签传播子问题，利用图结构传播约束并施加一致性，符合图与流形正则化方向。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","reason_zh":"论文使用成对约束进行约束聚类，是否按本词表归为弱监督不明确；摘要未说明以不完整实例标签替代完整真值，且该设定更直接对应半监督学习。"}],"input_issues":[]}
